Container.Name: NetSpy
Container.Description: Live network + disk monitoring: per-interface, per-process and per-container throughput, disk I/O, CPU/RAM, latency and a settings page.
Container.Overview: Web dashboard showing real-time network + disk monitoring of Unraid (and other hosts): interface rates, per-process breakdown (incl. SMB sessions per client), per-container traffic, disk I/O per process, CPU/RAM per process and latency/health. One image, two roles — this template installs the web role; add agents on other hosts (TrueNAS/Debian) via the repo's docker-compose.yml.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: network monitor traffic throughput dashboard disk io cpu ram latency settings servers
Container.Changes: v0.5.x: disk I/O + CPU/RAM tabs, SMB sessions per client IP, connection counts, latency/health monitor, settings page (servers.yaml in /netspy/config), config volume added to the template

Config.Name: ROLE
Config.Description: Role: web = dashboard + local sampler (this host); agent = collector for another web instance.

Config.Name: SERVERS
Config.Description: Servers the dashboard polls, semicolon-separated: Name=local;Name=http://host:8091. 'local' samples this host directly; http://... polls an agent on another host.

Config.Name: UPLINK
Config.Description: Optional override of the uplink interfaces (comma-separated, e.g. br0,bond0). Empty = auto-detect via default route (br0 on Unraid).

Config.Name: PORT:8090
Config.Description: Host port of the web UI. Host networking: the value IS the host port.

Config.Name: PORT:8091
Config.Description: Host port of the agent API (used by other hosts' dashboards to poll this one). Host networking: the value IS the host port.

Config.Name: AGENT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Shared token for agent API access — must be identical on the web instance and every agent (set a long random value).

Config.Name: DOCKER_SOCK
Config.Description: Docker socket path for per-container rows. Keep the 'Docker Socket' path mapping below active; set to empty to disable.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Mount the Docker socket (read-only) so container names appear in the process list (per-container throughput).

Config.Name: Config Volume
Config.Description: Base directory for the settings page — servers.yaml is stored in the /netspy/config subfolder (created automatically). After install, make it world-writable on the host: chmod 777 /mnt/user/appdata/netspy (container runs as root with cap_drop ALL and needs write access).
